description: Token-based CSS variables, reusable component library, semantic naming conventions, and accessibility standards (ARIA, keyboard navigation). Enables consistent styling and easy theme customization.

features.title: CSS Design Tokens
features.description: CSS custom properties for color palette, typography scale, spacing units, elevation/shadow tokens, and motion/animation curves. Single source of truth consumed by all components.
features.mvpScope: Color, typography, spacing, elevation tokens as CSS custom properties with dark-mode variants
features.v2Scope: Animation curves, z-index scale, border-radius tokens, token documentation site, design token API for programmatic access

features.title: Reusable Component Library
features.description: Core UI components: Button, Card, Form/Input, Badge, Avatar, Modal/Dialog, Toast/Alert, Navigation elements. All consume design tokens, support ARIA attributes, and follow semantic naming.
features.mvpScope: Button, Card, Input, Badge, Avatar, Modal with token-based styling and basic ARIA
features.v2Scope: Data Table, Dropdown/Select, Tooltip, Tabs, Accordion, Skeleton loaders, complex form layouts with validation

features.title: Semantic Naming Conventions
features.description: BEM-inspired naming strategy for CSS classes, component-scoped identifiers, and token reference patterns. Ensures predictable, maintainable selectors across the codebase.
features.mvpScope: Naming convention document, lint rules, core component patterns with consistent naming
features.v2Scope: Automated naming audit tooling, IDE plugin/extension for autocomplete, migration scripts for legacy selectors

features.title: Accessibility Standards
features.description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance baked into every component: ARIA roles/states/properties, keyboard navigation (tab order, focus trapping, shortcuts), focus management, color contrast ratios, screen reader testing.
features.mvpScope: Core ARIA patterns for Button, Card, Modal, Input; keyboard nav for interactive elements; minimum 4.5:1 contrast; visible focus indicators
features.v2Scope: Full WCAG audit suite, reduced-motion preference support, high-contrast theme, screen reader regression tests, accessibility statement page

features.title: Theme Customization System
features.description: Light/dark mode toggle, system-preference detection, theme persistence (localStorage), and a mechanism for injecting custom color palettes by overriding token values.
features.mvpScope: Light/dark mode with OS preference detection, localStorage persistence, theme toggle component
features.v2Scope: Custom palette editor UI, brand theming for white-label deployments, animated theme transitions, per-user theme profiles

features.title: Component Documentation
features.description: Living documentation for every component: usage examples, prop/API tables, code snippets, accessibility notes, and visual previews. Enables developer self-service.
features.mvpScope: Markdown docs per component with code examples and prop tables, integrated into the project docs site
features.v2Scope: Interactive playground (Storybook-like), automated prop table generation from TypeScript, visual regression snapshots, usage analytics
